evidence_summary: Fi-Sonic is a distinct Australian amplifier/effects identity founded by Phil Dreoni in Marrickville, Sydney. Contemporary-ad evidence places a Fi-Sonic fuzz product in 1965, while surviving documentation confirms a Fuzz-Blender MkIV and records Dreoni's confirmation that the pedal was one of his creations. The archive should treat the plain Fuzz-Blender and MkIV as one builder lineage with separate product/generation states, not duplicate builders. Unknown intermediate MkII/MkIII states remain discovery candidates rather than invented models.
